en.t: Then there was Yoko, for example,

units.source_text: 她就连在火车上也像年轻母亲那样忘我地照拂这个男人，把他护送回来；

en.t: even on the train she had tended this man with the selflessness of a young mother and brought him back safely;

units.source_text: 今早她又给同这个男人有着微妙关系的驹子送替换衣裳来，

en.t: and this morning she had brought a change of clothes to Komako, who had a delicate connection with him,

units.source_text: 她心里又是怎么想的呢？

en.t: what could she have been thinking?
